title: Sessions can now spawn in their own git worktree
body: Parallel agents on one repo never edit the same checkout again.
Toggle it on the new-session form (n), with alt+w on the quick prompt,
or set the default for both in settings (s).
Deleting a session cleans up its worktree and branch when they are clean.

title: Updates and tips now land here
body: Release notes, known issues, and tips from the maintainer show up in
this card next to the computer stats. M opens the full list,
x dismisses a message for good, and enter opens its link.
